editorial.blurb: Mazala Pizza brings the bold, vibrant flavors of Indian cuisine to Chicago-style pizza with remarkable care and creativity.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Tikka Pizza or Manchurian Pizza if you can handle heat—reviewers rave about these signature fusions, though the Manchurian runs quite spicy. The staff is known for going above and beyond with requests and occasionally throwing in freebies.
